text_block_list.text: "Hey, Trainer! Thanks for the day off!"
choice_data_list: Were you able to get some good rest?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It had been a while since just the 
two of us hung out, so we went around 
doing all sorts of fun stuff!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Browsing through random shops, and the 
food court! Pigging out together!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, because of that I had no room for 
dinner and got scolded by Bro, though.

"As she happily talks about the time spent 
with her little sister— it seems Jungle 
Pocket had a truly fulfilling day off."
